title: Business risk of nearly right code: Amazon outage incident
summary: Reports of faulty AI-generated code contributing to Amazon outages in early March. Amazon disputes the AI cause, attributing it to user error, but industry CTOs are using it as a case study for the risks of AI-assisted deployments.

title: Show HN: Optio – Orchestrate AI coding agents in K8s to go from ticket to PR
summary: Orchestration system that automates the full lifecycle from ticket to merged PR using Claude Code/Codex. Features CI-failure feedback loops and auto-resume capabilities.

title: Show HN: Fleeks – Substrate for agents to verify/deploy in live environments
summary: Execution substrate that gives agents an 'Execution Bridge' to spin up ephemeral environments for verification and deployment, moving them from 'code generators' to 'systems engineers'.

title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM) by Microsoft
summary: Microsoft/GitHub open-sourced APM to manage agent dependencies (skills, rules) with lockfiles and security auditing for hidden Unicode/supply-chain attacks. Directly addresses the 'Agent Supply Chain' risk.

title: Show HN: Fly – Release artifacts management via coding agent
summary: JFrog tool that lets coding agents manage release binaries, promoting fixes to staging/production and capturing AI-generated architectural summaries for each release.
